theorems.name: Submission.gwe_gta_row_bounds
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (D : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), (∀ (j : Fin ℓ) (r : Rn n), (∀ v : Rn n, inner ℝ r v = D v j) → ‖r‖ ≤ ‖D‖) ∧ ∃ R : Fin ℓ → Rn n, (∀ (j : Fin ℓ) (v : Rn n), inner ℝ (R j) v = D v j) ∧ ∑ j : Fin ℓ, ‖R j‖ ^ 2 = hsNormSq D
